page.overview:
Who is The Thorn?

The Thorn was a planeswalker and the main foe of Tempé. He was mentioned in The Cursed Land.

It is suggested that the Thorn gained the upper hand in their conflict as of the Mending of the Clan Tree of Cridhe.
